entries.title: Help becomes a set of pages, with guides
entries.body: Help now has a contents page, a page for each topic and each mode, one page of common questions, and four guides: for a first article, for students, for reviewers and for experts. Search covers the text of every page, and older links to a Help section open its new page. A Help link sits on every bottom bar, signed-out visitors see the site's usual bar on Help and the other information pages, and the page on adding articles explains what Stop does.

entries.title: Author lists start folded away
entries.body: On a paper, the run of authors, affiliations and contact lines under the title now starts folded, so you can go straight into the article; when the app is unsure a line belongs there, it stays showing. A 'Show authors and details' button near the title opens the run, and nothing is removed. The title now appears once rather than twice, the back arrow above it is gone because the Spideryarn logo in the bottom bar leads to your library, and author names are read from more arXiv pages.

entries.title: Five modes move into a More menu
entries.body: Quotes, Glossary, FAQ, Ideas and Timeline now open from a More button on the bottom bar, and the command bar still lists every mode. When an article opens, the bar fades in after a second, unless your device asks for reduced motion. Pressing Tab first offers 'Skip to modes', which jumps to the mode buttons.

entries.title: Dictation runs for up to fifteen minutes
entries.body: Dictation now runs for up to fifteen minutes; in the last minute a countdown shows and a chime sounds, and a second chime marks the stop. Before, a long dictation could stop with no sign. Feedback reports can be up to 20,000 characters, room for a long dictated one.

entries.title: Referee holds up to 200 criteria
entries.body: In Referee, a list of criteria can hold up to 200; adding one at that limit is refused, nothing is deleted, and your wording is kept as a draft. Text a document hides from you but the AI would read has its own Hidden text view, in plain words, with repeated findings shown once with a count.

entries.title: Modes wait and switch parts the same way
entries.body: Every mode now waits with the same line, shown only when a wait is not over at once, and its space is held so the panel does not jump when the words arrive. The buttons that switch between a mode's parts share one look and scroll sideways when crowded. On touch screens, small controls get larger tap areas.

entries.title: Stop and run-again do what you pressed
entries.body: Pressing Stop as an article's last step finishes now keeps and publishes it, where the same press could lose it. Run-again buttons such as Find more and Regenerate stay disabled until the new result has loaded, so a second press cannot start a second run. Imports that hit a server error part-way now end in an error you can retry.

entries.title: Clearer failures, and typing in Japanese or Chinese
entries.body: Failed requests show the app's own sentence, not the browser's, and panels that can tell 'nothing yet' from a failure keep their Generate button when a later check fails. Enter or Escape used to pick characters in Japanese, Chinese and similar typing no longer empties a chat draft, saves a rename, closes a panel or clears a search box.
